members.gloss: one like a son of man

derivations.note: #1758 §9, §11.1b; 17.1(i), (k). The Septuagint's lampstand and Hebrews' are one; the seven lampstands are the Apocalypse's.

derivations.title: The vote in Acts: Philo's form or Revelation's
derivations.note: The test of 5.2: Acts has the vote in Philo's form, brought against, a vote of condemnation. It does not have Revelation's white vote. At this locus the arrow does not run through Revelation.

derivations.title: The manna in the ark (corrected: no derived state)
derivations.note: Corrected at v0.8. v0.3 read Hebrews' περικεκαλυμμένην as the manna 'covered', a state derived from Revelation's 'hidden'. In the seat the participle is the ark's: 'the ark of the covenant covered on every side with gold', and the manna is in a golden jar, as at Exod 16:33. Hebrews has the manna and not Revelation's hiddenness; the Septuagint supplies it. A control fits.

derivations.title: The name on the head
derivations.note: #1758 §7b.3. Philo: 'four engravings of a name'. Rev 19:11–16 gives the rider four names.

derivations.title: As dead; fear not
derivations.note: With the earthquake and 'white as snow' (above), Matt 28:2–5 holds Rev 1:14, 1:17 and 16:18.

derivations.title: The wedding parable, gathered
derivations.note: Matthew's parable has what Luke's lacks: the wedding, the rest who kill and are destroyed by the king's armies (στρατεύματα: in the Gospels only here and Luke 23:11; Rev 19:14, 19), the garment, 'many called, few chosen'.

derivations.title: The white robe
derivations.note: Four tombs, four whites, each with its own place in the Apocalypse: Mark's στολὴν λευκήν (7:9), Matthew's λευκὸν ὡς χιών (1:14), John's ἐν λευκοῖς (3:4), Luke's ἀστραπτούσῃ.

derivations.title: Herod's supper
derivations.note: μεγιστᾶνες: Mark 6:21, Rev 6:15 and 18:23, and nowhere else in the New Testament. The supper where the Baptist's head is served has the guests of the supper of God.

derivations.title: Authority, scorpions, harm
derivations.note: With Luke 10:18 (Satan fallen from heaven; Rev 12:9, 9:1) and 10:20 (names written in heaven; Rev 13:8, 21:27).

derivations.title: The place, in Hebrew
derivations.note: Ἑβραϊστί: five times in John, twice in Revelation (9:11; 16:16), nowhere else in the New Testament.
